verdict.rationale: Latham's own Emerging Companies & Growth page says it draws on its capital markets and M&A strength to position clients for an optimal liquidity event, and that it has helped clients go public through direct listings and deSPACs. LathamDrive also organizes founder resources through the 'Liquidity' and 'Beyond IPO' stages, so the firm itself documents carrying startups from formation to exit. Missing for 10: specific venture-backed M&A or IPO deal examples or case studies, dedicated exit-focused practice pages in the evidence, and independent corroboration of exit track record.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages
